claims.statement: For the explicit systematic product encoder f in construction.py (41 fixed [48,24] blocks and one fixed [32,16] block) and deterministic BFS-syndrome decoder g in decoder.py, on BSC(1/10) with uniform 1000-bit U, eps(f,g)<=B as proved in proof.md. Here B=1-floor(10^100*s48^41*s32)/10^100, reduced as declared, and s48,s32 are the exact success probabilities computed from every code-specific syndrome leader in verify.py.

For the same product encoder f and BFS-syndrome decoder g, the literal straight-line bsc-ops-v1 program generated by decoder.py executes exactly W=1804<=2^(10817/1000) primitives on every 2000-bit input, with three registers and fewer than 2^32 memory words including all fixed tables.

experiments.purpose: Build every code-specific coset leader by exact BFS, compute the exact ML block error and outward-rounded rational bound, and count the complete straight-line decoder with the byte-identical reference counter.

title: Explicit seeded [48,24]/RM32 product code with exact ML block error
